domain_question.en: How are deployable technical capabilities built, secured, integrated and maintained?

typical_fields.en: Computer science, engineering, applied mathematics, cybersecurity, robotics, biomedical engineering

output_unit.en: Reviewed feature increments, alert investigations, validated pipeline changes, infrastructure change reviews, site device commissioning tests

recurring_boundary.en: Operators approve changes; model deployment requires a defined use case, baseline comparison and human escalation; testing requires written scope

problem.en: unreliable software, insecure infrastructure, fragmented data, and unvalidated automation impose real operating costs. Selling generic labor hours invites price competition and may create labor-law exposure if clients direct supplied personnel.

premium_offer.en: independently tested, multilingual software/data outcomes with maintenance, security evidence, observability, and bounded service commitments. Potential buyers include Tunisian SMEs and export clients in Francophone, European, and Arabic-speaking markets. Start with 105 plus a narrow 108 analytics deliverable if the founding expert is qualified; do not simultaneously open an SOC, robotics lab, or quantum program.

delivery_economics.en: use paid discovery, fixed-scope releases, change-controlled milestones, and support retainers. Differentiate through accountable acceptance and security, not claims of unlimited AI autonomy. Clarify 107 hosting versus 112 developer platforms; 109 model engineering versus 093 AI governance; 068 energy research versus 119 installation. Track defects, restoration tests, data reconciliation, task-specific model performance, retention, and contribution margin.
